# NainNotify

> Asynchronous notification gateway with real-time delivery tracing, built on .NET, MassTransit and RabbitMQ, with an interactive demo client.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://notify.naindev.com/): the interactive studio
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/NainNotify): repository, architecture notes and documentation
- [Author site](https://www.naindev.com/): Aitor Nain Mendoza Vallejo (NainDev)
